name: Hyoudou Hibiki
source:
Hibiki is a close combat instructor at the academy to teach students how to use AD technologies effectively. She is also a decorated former soldier who retired from her career in order to become a professor at the academy.

[spoiler]She also became the adoptive mother of [url=/c17131]Masato[/url] and [url=/c17128]Ria[/url] 2 years after the death of their real parents, being on a secret mission before and being a young cousin of their father.[/spoiler]
translation:
Hibiki is a close combat instructor at the academy to teach students how to use AD technologies effectively. She is also a decorated former soldier who retired from her career in order to become a professor at the academy.

[spoiler]She also became the adoptive mother of [url=/c17131]Masato[/url] and [url=/c17128]Ria[/url] 2 years after the death of their real parents, being on a secret mission before and being a young cousin of their father.[/spoiler]
